defective_pattern: Failing to execute physical disk decontamination (e.g., renaming to .stale.json or removing from 03_deliverables/) during learning graduation, which leaves stale validation reports on disk.
why_defective: Stale validation reports on disk cause recursive validation hooks to continuously block progress by falsely detecting a failed validation state.
observed_symptoms: Validation hooks recursively and continuously block progress.
Stale validation reports (like validation_report.json) remain in 03_deliverables/legacy_validation/.
corrective_remedy: During graduation, physically enforce de-indexing of any stale validation reports by renaming 03_deliverables/legacy_validation/validation_report.json to 03_deliverables/legacy_validation/validation_report.stale.json (or removing the directory).

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detecting un-renamed validation_report.json files in legacy validation directories inside deliverables.
